objective: Reassess representational coverage of frozen AssertionCarrier v2 against all 34 previously author-reviewed AHV2-8 relations without disclosing the previous carrier verdicts or mappings to the reviewer.

sampling.population: all 34 relations in frozen AHV2-8 target, no exclusions
sampling.target_order: all 8 frozen target claims in frozen order, each with frozen relation order
sampling.review_order_rule: For review position i=0..33, choose target index (11*i+5)%34. 11 and 34 are coprime, so each target appears exactly once.

allowed: existing available source locator and access classification
author-reviewed ClaimIR relation kind, ordered node arguments and source description
source span locators clearly marked summaries unless original verified
all original ClaimIR node descriptions for optional semantic references
frozen v2 schema and its legal predicates, qualifiers, binding roles, object types, modifiers
hidden_from_review_packet: previous v2 mappings, gap reason labels and rationales
reviewer_exposure.limitation: The old result remains in public version-controlled history. This is a verdict-masked reviewer-facing package, not inaccessible double-blind masking.

adjudication.step_1: Check source fidelity (if source truly inspected) and mark ABSTRACT_CHECKED, FULL_TEXT_CHECKED, or SOURCE_NOT_VERIFIED. Existing provenance locator descriptions are paraphrases, not automatically verified quotations.
adjudication.step_2: Independently reconstruct the source proposition, separating observed effect, statistical evidence, model prediction, authors' inference, and review synthesis where applicable. Do not invent source content beyond inspected material.
adjudication.step_3: Attempt expression using only the exact frozen v2 schema. FULL requires explicit predicate, typed argument binding, applicable qualifiers, directionality and evaluation; do not encode missing semantics in free-text scope or invented layers.
adjudication.step_4: Submit FULL with the mapping and core-semantic-preservation justification, GAP with an explicit missing distinction, UNDERDETERMINED if the source meaning admits multiple materially different readings, or SOURCE_NOT_VERIFIED if the reviewer cannot confirm the claim from available source material.
adjudication.step_5: Allow SOURCE_CLAIM_DISPUTE when the frozen ClaimIR differs from the original source. Keep the original record frozen and route any proposed corrections to a separate provenance issue without retroactively altering this test.

human_blinding_boundary: The original ClaimIR author has previously seen aggregate v2 results. If the author serves as reviewer, resulting process is a verdict-masked author challenge and must not be represented as independent external adjudication. External assessor judgment requires a different reviewer with no earlier results supplied.
comparison_lock: Do not compare with old per-relation verdicts or derive v3 vocabulary until all 34 reviewer decisions are frozen or a documented stop condition is reached. Count UNDERDETERMINED and SOURCE_NOT_VERIFIED separately, never force them into FULL/GAP.
independence_limit: A tool validator can check completeness, fixed-source fidelity, legal vocabulary and response consistency, but cannot prove semantic correctness, reviewer independence or substantive source access.
